_about: Fights that a wipe does not end the game for (story/fight_retry.gd). Each rule names the fights it covers: `fights` (ids) and/or `prefix` (an id prefix, limited to `locations` when that is given). On a wipe the party rises with every Hit Point and power back, the Narrator says the first of `keys` that exists ({fight} is the encounter id), and the fight begins again: `restart` names a different entry to begin (default: the same one); `spawns` (location id to spawn names, the first one the map has) puts the party back at that entry first; without it the party stays where it stands. `count_flag` counts the retries. Rules are read in order, so a fight that a later rule's prefix also covers keeps the earlier rule. Whoever was already dead when the fight began stays dead. `rise_after_win`: after a won fight, whoever fell in it (dead or down at 0 Hit Points) gets up with 1 Hit Point (Act 1's train, where nothing can raise the dead yet).
